name: iron-asylum-heroku
description: Heroku's manifest. It sits at the repo root because Heroku deploys the branch main from GitHub as it is (and backend/scripts/heroku.sh deploy puts it at the root of the tree it pushes). npm run build builds the website and the admin (frontends/), then the backend, whose build also builds the app's page from frontends/app/src/legacy/src into backend/app-web/. npm start runs the one server: the website at /, the admin at /admin/, the app at /app/ and the API. GitHub Pages serves this folder too, so nothing here is secret.

scripts.build: npm ci --prefix frontends --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build --prefix frontends && rm -rf frontends/node_modules frontends/.angular && npm ci --prefix backend --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build --prefix backend && npm prune --prefix backend --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund
